dedupe_keys.name: green roofs in the central activities zone london mapped from 2015 aerial imagery

description: This dataset maps existing green roofs in London's Central Activities Zone (CAZ), which makes up about two per cent of London's area, from 2015 aerial imagery. It is published by the Greater London Authority on the London Datastore and listed on data.gov.uk. Green roofs were digitised by hand in ArcMap from true-colour and infrared composites, using the CAZ boundary and the London 500 metre Ordnance Survey grid; infrared helped separate living vegetation from Astroturf and cut through shadow, and Google Earth's elevation view helped judge whether green areas were raised. Where only the edges of roof terraces are densely planted, the vegetation, not the whole roof was mapped. Coverage is the CAZ only, because manual mapping is slow. Access: GIS files in a ZIP and a PDF map of green roof locations by size. Licence: not stated on the data.gov.uk entry; London Datastore terms were not read today. Free. Caveats: a 2015 snapshot, manual interpretation. Simulation uses: green infrastructure inputs to urban heat and surface water models. Related records: the automatic survey of green roofs in London (whole city, 2019 and 2021).
